<!-- pr-reviewer: e5d21409a4b000bedd6e9362fae17c9e36f7dd88 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- Only `site/` files and the decision record change. No Rust, no process files, no snapshot PNGs, no CHANGELOG edit.
- `site/static/icons/op-rotary-flow.png`, `tool-form-mill.png` and `LICENSES.txt` are byte copies of `assets/ui/` (verified with `cmp`). Correct for a site icons resync.
- The Rotary Flow section matches the shipped app: the seed (feed 1200, plunge feed 300, climb on, tolerance 0.05, clearance stock-top + 25 read as a ball-center radius, lead/lag 0 and max tilt 90), the picks law (no Top Z/Bottom Z, chains bound the band), the stated-axis law (op's own axis, else machine's, else free fit as for Rotary Contour) and the quoted refusal strings (verified against `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary_flow.rs` and `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`).
- The two label-map updates point the `New tool…` label at `tool_library_dialog/list.rs`, where the string now is (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library_dialog/list.rs:93`); the old `tool_library.rs` does not exist. The checks are not weaker - same label, one file path changed.
- The SVG `RotaryFlow` view follows the file's established pattern (offset by 240, aria title/desc, original schematic).
- `docs/decisions/4106-site-tests.md` follows the decisions README format.

Results merged with main
- Trial merge with `origin/main` (a5b8734a): no conflicts.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests` on the PR head: 104 tests, OK. (Zola 0.23.6, sha256-checked against the release.yml pin; node 22.11.0 for the search-query tests; all 104 pass.) No cargo build or gate: no Rust change, per the review scope.

Targeted tests
- Pinning tests run and green: `test_guide_icons.GuideIcons.test_component_static_icons_and_license_match_app`, `test_operation_reference.OperationReferencePictures.test_every_operation_has_section_and_picture`, `test_first_4axis_part` and `test_first_continuous_4axis_part` label-map checks, plus the full suite (104 OK).
- No post or toolpath change, so no example catalog suites. No heavy lanes: no code change (docs/site only).

Requested before merge
- None.

Notes (not blocking)
- The release-side step (branch `site/v0.27.0` with the same site-only fix and a `site_only` dispatch) stays with the maintainer per the issue's done criteria; the PR body names it.
- The `LICENSE.txt` copy also carries the unrelated solidcore pin update from `assets/ui/LICENSES.md`. Correct byte-copy behavior, just noting the scope.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
